response.overview: This is a reimagining of Frank Castle, exploring a younger take on the man who becomes the Punisher. Frank Castle, once a young husband, father, and Marine, is consumed by grief and transformed into a relentless vigilante after the loss of his wife and children.  After two years spent trying to escape his violent past and find peace, a new wave of bloodshed forces Frank back into the fight. But as his dark crusade begins, he must confront the true cost of his vengeance—not only in the streets, but within his own soul.
response.title: The Punisher: Nightmare
